# GitHub ruleset request schema fixture

`github_ruleset_request_schema_2022-11-28.json` is an offline, faithful extraction of the request-body constraints used by the GitHub REST repository-ruleset create and update endpoints (`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets` and `PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets/{ruleset_id}`).

Provenance:

- API version: `2022-11-28`
- Upstream source: `https://github.com/github/rest-api-description/blob/642960c36df7752f0b1aa307a4bdb99d12dd7ff5/descriptions/api.github.com/api.github.com.2022-11-28.json`
- Fixture scope: all fields and rule variants emitted or preserved by `scripts/reconcile_ruleset.py`, including required pull-request parameters, code-scanning thresholds, and the optional integer `integration_id`.
- Fixture SHA-256: `0b5388857ff360db6d169c7223fdd9918e1271f9665c8bb8b0fa45e70fe7a597`
- Tests intentionally perform no network access; the fixture is loaded from this directory.

The fixture is reviewed as a versioned contract. Update the upstream commit, fixture, and this provenance record together when GitHub changes the API schema.

# Gradle Problems Report fixture

`gradle-problems/problems-report.html` was generated by Gradle 9.8.2 (`compileJava` with `-Xlint:all` plus 40 problems reported through the public Problems API with hostile HTML/Markdown labels), so it includes Gradle's own per-id listing cap and skipped-count `summaries`. Sanitization kept the report-data `<script>` block byte-for-byte except for replacing the local build directory with `/__w/demo/demo`, and replaced Gradle's stylesheet and minified renderer with comments. Regenerate it with a current Gradle release when the embedded report format changes.

# Release notes fixtures

`release-notes/<repository>-<release PR>/` holds four real Release Please PRs captured on 2026-11-07: quokkify/ci-kit#534, quokkify/q4j#755, quokkify/archgate#39 and quokkify/java-test-automation-template#20 (the last one still carries a v1 rich block). Each directory has the release PR body as Release Please wrote it (`release-pr-body.md`), a `CHANGELOG.md` built from the same notes plus one older version, the merged source PRs (`sources.json`: title, labels, merge time and a sanitized body that keeps only the published sections or the first Renovate `Package | Change` table), the hidden-type commits between the previous tag and the release revision (`hidden-commits.json`), the repository's `changelog-sections` (`config.json`), and the rendered goldens `expected-release-pr-body.md` and `expected-CHANGELOG.md`. Regenerate the goldens only for an intended format change and review the diff line by line.
